name: baseline_nplayer_matched
description: Matched group-size design: group sizes 2/3/4/5 crossed with the same risk treatments 0.1/0.6/0.9, all through ai_race/engine_nplayer with one prompt template. The three names in 'games' are the derivation SOURCE for the mechanism (the N=3 files); the task overrides only 'name', 'nPlayers', and 'agents' per group size in 'groupSizes', and fails closed unless the derived config is byte-equal to the checked-in ai_race_nplayer_n{N}_risk_* file wherever one exists (N=3,4,5). N=2 has no checked-in game file and is derived the same way, which is exactly what supplies the missing two-player baseline. Changing the group size necessarily changes the payoff rule, the opponent count, and the prompt length together; that dependence IS the game and this design does not identify a 'pure' group-size effect.
